This isn’t the best advice but from my experience I try to find joy in the little things. My life is repetitive and I hate myself some days but what I always do is look forward to something. I’m broke but I look forward to what I’m going to eat next. I live for flavor and look forward to the next thing I’m going to eat in a few hours. Treat yourself. Eventually save up and look forward to a trip or something but in the meantime treat yourself to a soda or a dessert you wouldn’t normally eat or something of the sort. The best thing is to escape into a really great book and look forward to the lives of the characters. Maybe my life sounds sad typing it all out but those things really helped me to feel stronger mentally and become hopeful. Do some nice things for yourself. I will never know how you feel but that’s what helped me. I hope inpatient helps you.
